headline: China Railway Resources Eyes $600 Million Investment to Revive Zimbabwean Gold Mines
summary: China Railway Resources Group is exploring a $600 million investment to revive and expand four gold mines in Zimbabwe.
why: Zimbabwe has experienced rapid growth in gold output over the past decade, and foreign infrastructure investments seek to further expand extraction capacity.

impacts.name: Zimbabwe
impacts.why: Inflows of foreign capital into mining infrastructure can increase domestic gold production and exports.
